title: Accounts Payable Workflow Automation
summary: See how Concentrix automated accounts payable workflows to improve efficiency by 20%, strengthen audit readiness, and increase Quality SLA performance by 90%.
body_markdown:
## Outcomes


The new workflow streamlined accounts payable operations, strengthened governance, improved process visibility, and enhanced audit readiness. By replacing manual, spreadsheet-driven activities with a centralized digital platform, the client established a scalable foundation for future growth.


300K+ transactions processed with scalability for future growth


1,000+ vendors managed through a centralized workflow


20% efficiency improvement


90% improvement in Quality SLA performance


**The Concentrix Difference**


Concentrix combines Finance & Accounting expertise with low-code innovation to simplify complex operations. By transforming a spreadsheet-driven AP process into a secure, scalable workflow, we helped the client improve control, efficiency, and compliance while maximizing existing technology investments.


**Smarter AP operations. Stronger governance. Scalable growth.**
